# Sunset — DSC (Document Structural Core) specification corpus

> Machine-first index for agentic consumers: implement DSC, validate
> descriptors, and run the conformance suite against your implementation.

Scope note: this file serves documentation discovery, not tool
registration — it is not the tool-registry `llms.txt` ruled out of scope
in the dulce-de-leche checklist (scope ruling closing `sunset-408`,
recorded in [status.md](docs/src/status.md)).

## Start here

- [for-agents.md](docs/src/for-agents.md) — agent integration brief:
  descriptor contract, validation API surface, four reports, conformance
  boundary (applies to DSC 0.3 deployed specs, 2026-10-15).
- [what-is-dsc.md](docs/src/what-is-dsc.md) — explanation: what DSC is,
  why it separates views/regions/claims, and which version applies to you.

## Guides

- [first-descriptor.md](docs/src/first-descriptor.md) — tutorial: build
  and validate your first 0.3 descriptor with the shipped reference
  validator, including the canonical tagged example descriptor.
- [integrate.md](docs/src/integrate.md) — how-tos: adapt real PDF/EPUB
  carriers into descriptors, run the conformance suite, read the four
  reports, and classify honestly.

## Reference

- [reference.md](docs/src/reference.md) — lookup index: the seven
  capability specs, the `dsc03` module surface, conformance label
  taxonomy, and fixture catalog.

## Normative specs (deployed 0.3 truth, seven capabilities)

- [document-core](openspec/specs/document-core/spec.md) — typed descriptor
  wire contract, canonical form, complete typed error reasons.
- [document-structure](openspec/specs/document-structure/spec.md) —
  physical vs logical views, `contains`/`realizes`/`precedes` edge
  semantics.
- [document-semantics](openspec/specs/document-semantics/spec.md) — typed
  namespaced claims, versioned vocabularies, scoped cross-edition
  comparison.
- [document-evidence](openspec/specs/document-evidence/spec.md) — claim
  origins, `asserted_without_evidence`, coexisting disputed claims,
  transformation lineage DAG.
- [document-adapters](openspec/specs/document-adapters/spec.md) — preserve
  source-native observations without OCR; structured JSON is the mandatory
  baseline adapter.
- [document-conformance](openspec/specs/document-conformance/spec.md) —
  per-instance outcomes kept separate from suite readiness and lint.
- [document-ontology-boundaries](openspec/specs/document-ontology-boundaries/spec.md) —
  out-of-core semantics represented without silent coercion; projection
  evaluator in `dsc03/boundaries.py`.

## Status and limits

- [status.md](docs/src/status.md) — corpus status: 0.2 executable truth vs
  deployed 0.3 specs, recorded deviations (each human pass supersedes),
  and the sunset-408 scope ruling.
- [baseline-limitations.md](docs/src/baseline-limitations.md) — known
  validation limits of the frozen 0.2 validator and what passing its
  checks establishes (and does not).
